description_excerpt: Job Description Primary Responsibilities Supervise the laboratory operations of functional lab to ensure its safety, effectiveness & efficiency and maintain standardized and aligned lab testing practices in the laboratory Maintains laboratory operation and equipment performance, develop workflow and operations. Ensure technician compliance, to follow SOP to perform the test, issue the reporting and arrange equipment maintenance. Implement and develop new method, instrumentation, and procedures, prepare testing protocol, develop and perform Proficiency Testing programs and accreditation.…
